modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo is probable to play Wednesday against the Clippers due to a sprained right wrist.
injury.detail: Antetokounmpo is dealing with a sprained wrist on his shooting hand, but it doesn't appear he has any intention of sitting out Wednesday's game. Check back closer to Wednesday's tipoff for official confirmation on his status.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game in Washington, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.
injury.detail: Johnson suffered a sprained left ankle in Saturday's 121-99 loss to New Orleans and was ruled out ahead of Monday's meeting with the Pacers. If Johnson can't get back on the floor Wednesday versus the Wizards, Luguentz Dort might make his second consecutive start.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knees) is now questionable for Wednesday against the Jazz.
injury.detail: Murphy was previously labeled as probable, so this is an ominous sign for his availability. If Murphy is unable to give it a go, Saddiq Bey and Herbert Jones could become more involved for the Pelicans.

injury.shortComment: Pritchard is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Milwaukee due to a right shoulder contusion, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
injury.detail: Pritchard's status is uncertain after he struggled in Monday's loss to Houston, finishing with four points on 0-for-7 shooting across 30 minutes. With Jayson Tatum (rest) also questionable and Devin Carter (illness) ruled out, Boston could be shorthanded Wednesday. Pritchard's availability should become clearer closer to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Smith is probable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks with a left finger sprain.
injury.detail: Smith is expected to play through the injury Wednesday, but his time as Chicago's starting center could be coming to an end. Nic Claxton (hamstring) is questionable to make his season debut, and his return would send Smith into a bench role in all likelihood.

injury.shortComment: Oubre (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Oubre is trying to move past a knee contusion Wednesday. Less playing time would be available for Jarace Walker if Oubre is healthy enough to play.

injury.shortComment: Sarr (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Atlanta.
injury.detail: Sarr is dealing with left knee soreness that could force him to miss another contest after sitting out Monday's win over Orlando. If the big man remains sidelined, Deandre Ayton could continue to handle an increased workload in Washington's frontcourt. Sarr's availability should become clearer closer to Wednesday's tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Jackson is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Heat with left groin soreness, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
injury.detail: Jackson is a late addition to the injury report, which is a bad sign for his chances of playing Wednesday. If Jackson is ultimately downgraded to out, Brook Lopez would likely remain in the starting center position for the Clippers.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (lower body injury management) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Toronto.
injury.detail: Johnson has already missed three games. However, it doesn't appear he will be sidelined Wednesday versus the Raptors. The 30-year-old veteran hasn't played well throughout the 2026-27 campaign, averaging a career-low 8.0 points along with 5.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.0 steals over 26.3 minutes per contest in three regular-season appearances.

injury.shortComment: Bamba (ankle) participated in Wednesday's morning shootaround, per Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune.
injury.detail: Bamba is trending in a positive direction ahead of Wednesday's game in New Orleans. He can be tentatively placed on the right side of his questionable designation.

injury.shortComment: Coulibaly (illness) is questionable for Wednesday against the Hawks.
injury.detail: Coulibaly was a late addition to the injury report after waking up under the weather. If the Wizards end up holding Coulibaly out, the team could turn to Khris Middleton and/or Will Riley.

injury.shortComment: Goodwin (calf) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Portland, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
injury.detail: Goodwin sustained a left calf injury in Monday's 116-113 loss to Golden State, ending his night after just 10 minutes. If Goodwin is sidelined Wednesday, Luke Kennard should see more action.

injury.shortComment: Post (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Indiana.
injury.detail: Post is in danger of missing his third consecutive contest because of a right ankle sprain. If Post remains sidelined Wednesday versus the Pacers, Kris Murray should continue to see more minutes.

injury.shortComment: White (calf) is probable for Wednesday's game in Brooklyn.
injury.detail: White came out of his regular-season debut unscathed and should be available for Wednesday's game. White saw 16 minutes of action in Monday's 124-91 loss to the Pistons, but he should be cleared for more playing time in his second game of the season.

injury.shortComment: Poeltl is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets due to left shoulder bursitis, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Poeltl is looking to avoid a third straight absence with the issue. If the veteran big man is unable to give it a go Wednesday, Collin Murray-Boyles should take on the lion's share of the center minutes for the Raptors.

injury.shortComment: Williams (back) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
injury.detail: Williams is battling lower back spasms, so his availability for Wednesday's meeting with Cleveland is in jeopardy. There are a few different directions head coach Mark Daigneault can go regarding the rotation, but if Williams doesn't suit up, it would likely open up more minutes for Micah Peavy, Kenrich Williams and Aday Mara.

injury.shortComment: Diallo (wrist) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.
injury.detail: Diallo played through the wrist issue Monday and logged six minutes off the bench in a 118-110 loss to Portland. He should see a similar workload Wednesday.

injury.shortComment: Gill (back) is questionable for Wednesday against the Hawks.
injury.detail: Gill's availability is uncertain as Washington deals with multiple injuries in its frontcourt. Gill's status should become clearer closer to tipoff, though he remains a limited fantasy option even if cleared to play.
